subject: Money
title: The Tax Gap
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Tax Gap.

hook.text: The U.S. tax gap is $688 billion per year. That's tax owed but never collected.

buildup.text: Most wage earners can't cheat—employers report income directly. The gap comes from self-reported income.

discovery.text: Business owners, landlords, and investors have more opportunity to underreport. Audits are the main deterrent.

twist.text: IRS funding was cut 20% since 2010. Fewer auditors means less enforcement, especially on the wealthy.

climax.text: The tax gap could fund entire programs. Not a new tax—just collecting what's already owed.

punchline.text: The money exists. The collectors don't.

quiz.question: What is the 'tax gap'?
options: Difference between tax rates of rich and poor
